MSFT.thesis: Azure + OpenAI distribution monetizes AI across cloud, Copilot and GitHub; capex financed by a fortress balance sheet.
MSFT.bear: Capex supercycle compresses FCF margins; OpenAI dependency and lagging in-house silicon.
MSFT.buy: Azure AI revenue re-accelerates while the capex guide stabilizes.
MSFT.sell: AI revenue decelerates while capex keeps climbing — the ROI gap widens.

AMZN.thesis: AWS AI ramp plus Trainium in-house silicon cuts unit costs; retail margins still expanding.
AMZN.bear: AWS loses AI share to Azure; capex intensity spikes ahead of revenue.
AMZN.buy: AWS growth re-acceleration with visible Trainium adoption.
AMZN.sell: AWS decelerates below hyperscaler peers for consecutive quarters.

GOOGL.thesis: Gemini + TPU is the only full silicon-to-app AI stack; search cash flow funds the buildout.
GOOGL.bear: LLMs disrupt search economics faster than Gemini and Cloud monetize.
GOOGL.buy: Search revenue proves resilient while Gemini/Cloud inflects.
GOOGL.sell: Search query and revenue erosion accelerates.

META.thesis: Open-weights Llama plus AI-driven ad targeting lift; giant GPU fleet already pays for itself in ranking.
META.bear: Massive AI capex with no direct revenue line; ad cycle risk.
META.buy: AI ad tools measurably lift pricing/engagement at stable capex.
META.sell: Capex guided up again without engagement or ARPU payoff.

CBRS.thesis: Wafer-scale engine differentiates on inference speed; G42 anchor funds the ramp.
CBRS.bear: Extreme single-customer concentration (G42), listing/IPO uncertainty, and NVDA's software moat.
CBRS.buy: Clean listing with a diversified order backlog.
CBRS.sell: G42 concentration persists or the listing stalls again.

AVGO.thesis: Arms dealer for hyperscaler ASICs (TPU, MTIA) while Tomahawk/Jericho silicon rides every AI fabric; VMware is a cash machine.
AVGO.bear: ASIC programs are lumpy; VMware leverage; customers can in-source design.
AVGO.buy: A new mega-customer ASIC program reaching production.
AVGO.sell: TPU program share loss or AI networking share erosion.

ARM.thesis: Royalty per chip on nearly every edge/mobile SoC; datacenter CPU share rising via Graviton and Grace.
ARM.bear: Royalty-rate ceiling, RISC-V encroachment, SoftBank overhang, rich multiple.
ARM.buy: Datacenter royalty mix inflects on v9 pricing.

CEVA.thesis: DSP/connectivity IP royalties with edge-AI NPU licensing optionality.
CEVA.bear: Sub-scale, handset-exposed, royalty growth chronically slow.

RMBS.thesis: Memory-interface chips (DDR5 RCD share) plus a patent-license annuity; HBM/server content tailwind.
RMBS.bear: Licensing plateaus; interface-chip competition from Montage/Renesas.
RMBS.buy: DDR5/MRDIMM content ramps with the server cycle.
RMBS.sell: Chip share loss or license renewals slipping.

SNPS.thesis: EDA duopoly taxing every tape-out; AI-assisted design (DSO.ai) and Ansys simulation deepen the moat.
SNPS.bear: China export restrictions, Ansys integration debt, design-start cyclicality.
SNPS.buy: Post-Ansys deleveraging with double-digit backlog growth.
SNPS.sell: China revenue cliff or bookings deceleration.

CDNS.thesis: Other half of the EDA duopoly; hardware emulation (Palladium) sold out on AI chip complexity.
CDNS.bear: Same China exposure; persistent valuation premium.
CDNS.buy: Emulation demand outpaces with building backlog.

TSM.thesis: Monopoly on leading-edge logic — every AI chip funnels through N3/N2; pricing power still rising.
TSM.bear: Taiwan geopolitics is THE tail risk; capex intensity; Samsung/Intel at 2nm (low probability).
TSM.buy: N2 ramp with gross margin holding above 55% through the capex peak.
TSM.sell: Cross-strait escalation or an N2 yield stumble.

AMKR.thesis: OSAT #2 catching advanced-packaging overflow as CoWoS capacity stays short.
AMKR.bear: Commodity assembly margins, cyclical utilization, Apple concentration.
AMKR.buy: AI packaging capacity fills with a margin lift.
AMKR.sell: Utilization rolls as CoWoS supply catches demand.

WDC.thesis: HDD duopoly levered to AI cold storage; nearline exabytes booming post-Sandisk split.
WDC.bear: HDD demand is cyclical; hyperscaler order air pockets.
WDC.buy: Nearline capacity sold out with pricing traction.

STX.thesis: HAMR leadership bends the density cost curve; AI data lakes drive nearline demand.
STX.bear: HAMR yield execution, cyclicality, balance-sheet leverage.
STX.buy: HAMR volume crossover with gross-margin expansion.
STX.sell: HAMR slips again or a pricing war starts.

SNDK.thesis: Pure-play NAND post-split; AI devices and inference storage optionality.
SNDK.bear: NAND is the worst memory commodity — chronic oversupply, no HBM exposure.
SNDK.buy: NAND pricing upcycle with industry supply discipline.

COHR.thesis: 800G transceiver leader with indium-phosphide vertical integration; broadest optical portfolio.
COHR.bear: Chinese transceiver price pressure; deal leverage from II-VI.

LITE.thesis: Cloud Light acquisition put it inside hyperscaler transceivers; CPO optionality.
LITE.bear: Customer concentration, telecom drag, execution history.

AAOI.thesis: Turnaround on hyperscaler 400G/800G orders after years in the wilderness.
AAOI.bear: Chronically unprofitable, serial diluter, brutal competition.
AAOI.buy: Sustained gross-margin improvement with anchor-customer volume.
AAOI.sell: Another dilutive raise or GM stall.

POET.thesis: Optical-interposer platform for co-packaged optics — wafer-level photonics integration bet.
POET.bear: Pre-revenue, unproven licensing model, ongoing dilution.
POET.buy: A volume design win with a tier-1 module maker.
POET.sell: Partnerships stall without converting to revenue.

DLR.thesis: Wholesale DC landlord with record leasing backlog and re-pricing power; power-banked land is the moat.
DLR.bear: REIT rate sensitivity, development capex, hyperscaler self-build.
DLR.buy: Rate relief plus accelerating cash re-leasing spreads.
DLR.sell: Leasing spreads compress or cap rates gap out.

EQIX.thesis: Interconnection-rich retail colo — the highest-moat DC REIT; edge inference thesis on top.
EQIX.bear: xScale capital needs, power constraints in core metros, premium valuation.
EQIX.buy: xScale AI leasing inflects with stable churn.

NRG.thesis: Texas load growth with a retail platform; data-center deals and new gas turbines add optionality.
NRG.bear: Merchant/retail margin volatility; DC letters of intent must convert.
NRG.buy: Signed data-center PPAs converting from LOIs.

SMR.thesis: Only NRC-approved SMR design; the pure-play on nuclear newbuild if orders ever firm.
SMR.bear: No firm orders at scale, CFPP cancellation history, dilution, cost inflation.
SMR.buy: A firm order book with a credible offtaker.

ETN.thesis: Electrical super-cycle: switchgear/power distribution backlog years deep; data-center vertical growing fastest.
ETN.bear: Cyclical industrial exposure; multiple already re-rated; backlog digestion.
ETN.sell: Order cancellations show up in backlog.

POWL.thesis: Custom switchgear for data centers and industry; record backlog with a net-cash balance sheet.
POWL.bear: Project lumpiness, oil & gas legacy mix, small-cap multiple swings.
POWL.buy: DC bookings mix keeps climbing with margins holding.
POWL.sell: Bookings roll over or margins fade.

HUBB.thesis: Grid components compounder riding the utility T&D upgrade cycle.
HUBB.bear: Less direct AI torque; utility capex timing risk.

ATKR.thesis: Conduit and cable management with data-center raceway exposure; cheap on normalized earnings.
ATKR.bear: Steel-conduit pricing normalization crushed earnings; import competition.
ATKR.buy: Pricing stabilizes with DC volume offsetting.

NVT.thesis: Liquid cooling plus enclosures/power distribution — focused electrical-infra play after thermal acquisitions.
NVT.bear: Integration risk; liquid-cooling competition from Vertiv and others.
NVT.buy: Liquid-cooling orders inflect as a share of mix.
NVT.sell: Cooling share loss or margin dilution.

VRT.thesis: Thermal + power for AI racks; liquid-cooling leader and NVIDIA reference-design partner with a huge backlog.
VRT.bear: Rising competition (Schneider, nVent, Asian OEMs), lumpy orders, margin pressure on mega-deals.
VRT.buy: Order reacceleration plus next-GPU-cycle content confirmation.
VRT.sell: Order growth stalls or GM compresses on competition.

MOD.thesis: Data-center cooling segment growing triple digits while legacy auto HVAC gets pruned.
MOD.bear: Legacy segments drag; DC cooling competition; capacity execution.
MOD.buy: DC segment margin and capacity expansion on track.

PWR.thesis: The electric-infrastructure EPC — transmission, substations, renewables; craft-labor scale is the moat.
PWR.bear: Labor inflation, large-project execution risk, full valuation.
PWR.buy: Backlog conversion accelerating with margins holding.

MTZ.thesis: Power-delivery and pipeline EPC pivoting hard toward grid and data-center work.
MTZ.bear: Leverage, spotty margin history, project concentration.

EME.thesis: Electrical/mechanical contractor actually fitting out the data centers; record RPOs, net cash, buybacks.
EME.bear: Cyclical construction; bid competition eventually normalizes margins.
EME.buy: DC RPOs keep compounding with margin stability.

FCX.thesis: Copper leverage — grid and DC demand meets a structural supply deficit; Grasberg is a tier-one asset.
FCX.bear: Pure commodity beta; Indonesia regulatory risk; recession kills copper.
FCX.buy: Copper breaks out on deficit with China stable.
FCX.sell: Global growth rolls; copper below incentive price.

MP.thesis: Only US rare-earth mine-to-magnet chain; DoD price floor; robotics/EV magnet demand.
MP.bear: NdPr price dependency, magnet-stage execution, China dumping.
MP.buy: Magnet capacity ramps with committed offtake.

AMAT.thesis: Broadest wafer-fab equipment portfolio; GAA, backside power and advanced packaging all expand its served market.
AMAT.bear: China export controls chop revenue; memory capex cyclicality.
AMAT.buy: Leading-edge capex upcycle with China stabilized.
AMAT.sell: WFE guidance cuts on China or memory.

LRCX.thesis: Etch/deposition leader levered to NAND recovery and HBM (TSV etch); services annuity compounds.
LRCX.bear: NAND capex still depressed; China mix was a crutch.

KLAC.thesis: Process-control near-monopoly with the best margins in WFE; inspection intensity rises every node.
KLAC.bear: Largest China exposure among peers; slow unit growth without AI.

ASML.thesis: EUV monopoly — every leading-edge wafer needs its litho; High-NA extends the moat a decade.
ASML.bear: China DUV restrictions, order lumpiness, Intel capex risk.
ASML.buy: EUV order book inflects on N2/18A/Samsung expansion.

TER.thesis: SoC test leader; AI compute and HBM test intensity rising; robotics optionality.
TER.bear: Mobile test cyclicality; Advantest strong in AI accelerators.
TER.buy: AI compute test orders inflect versus Advantest.

CAMT.thesis: Inspection/metrology for advanced packaging — pure picks-and-shovels on the HBM/chiplet bottleneck.
CAMT.bear: Small, KLA/Onto pushing in, order lumpiness.
CAMT.buy: HBM4 inspection orders broaden the customer base.

ONTO.thesis: Packaging metrology (Dragonfly) for HBM plus panel-level packaging litho optionality.
ONTO.buy: Panel-level packaging adoption plus HBM order resumption.

COHU.thesis: Test handlers/contactors — auto/industrial recovery play with modest AI content.
COHU.bear: Auto semi downturn persists; low AI torque.

AEHR.thesis: Wafer-level burn-in pivoting from collapsed SiC demand to AI processor burn-in.
AEHR.bear: SiC capex collapsed, extreme customer concentration, story stock.
AEHR.buy: AI burn-in orders from a named processor vendor.

ACMR.thesis: Cleaning/plating tools growing fast; cheap because the Shanghai subsidiary carries geopolitical discount.
ACMR.bear: US-listed China semi-equip — policy risk in both directions.
ACMR.buy: Ex-China customer wins validate the technology.
ACMR.sell: Export or listing rules tighten further.

INOD.thesis: AI data-engineering services for hyperscalers; revenue exploded off a tiny base.
INOD.bear: Services multiple, one mega-client concentration, thin moat versus Scale/Surge.

DDOG.thesis: Observability standard for cloud-native; LLM observability rides inference workload growth.
DDOG.bear: Usage-optimization cycles, OSS competition, premium multiple.
DDOG.buy: AI-native cohort revenue accelerating in disclosures.

NET.thesis: Edge network with Workers AI inference and zero-egress R2 undercutting cloud data taxes.
NET.bear: Perpetually premium valuation; edge-inference demand still unproven.
NET.buy: AI/Workers revenue becomes disclosed and material.
NET.sell: Growth decelerates below 25% with no AI proof.

CRWD.thesis: Endpoint security platform winner; AI is both the threat surface and the product (Charlotte).
CRWD.bear: Post-outage trust rebuild, premium valuation, Microsoft bundling.
CRWD.buy: Module attach and ARR reacceleration after outage credits roll off.

PANW.thesis: Security platformization consolidating point tools; AI-driven SOC as the next leg.
PANW.bear: Platformization discounts drag billings; hardware legacy.
PANW.buy: Next-gen security ARR compounding >30% with FCF holding.

ESTC.thesis: Search plus vector database for RAG workloads; Elasticsearch relevance in the AI stack.
ESTC.bear: OSS competition, hyperscaler bundling, choppy sales execution.
ESTC.buy: Elastic Cloud with vector adoption reaccelerates growth.

SNOW.thesis: Data cloud becoming the governed data layer for enterprise AI (Cortex).
SNOW.bear: Consumption optimization, Databricks rivalry, margin path questions.
SNOW.buy: Product revenue reacceleration with AI feature attach.

MDB.thesis: Document database with vector search for AI apps; Atlas consumption model.
MDB.bear: Postgres+pgvector gravity; consumption softness; vector-DB startups.
MDB.buy: Atlas growth stabilizes with AI workload wins.

PLTR.thesis: Ontology plus AIP as the enterprise AI operating layer; US government and commercial both accelerating.
PLTR.bear: One of the most extreme valuations in software; government deal concentration.
PLTR.buy: Commercial NRR and margins outpace even bull models at a reset multiple.

QCOM.thesis: On-device AI (Snapdragon X, auto cockpit) plus a licensing annuity — cheap relative to semis peers.
QCOM.bear: Apple modem roll-off, Android maturity, ARM license disputes.
QCOM.buy: Auto + PC diversification exceeds 30% of chip revenue.
QCOM.sell: Apple roll-off lands without offsetting growth.

AMBA.thesis: Edge-inference SoCs for automotive and IoT vision.
AMBA.bear: Sub-scale versus NVDA/QCOM; slow auto design-win cycles; inventory swings.
AMBA.buy: CV3 auto wins reaching production revenue.

NXPI.thesis: Auto MCU/analog leader; edge AI content growth on top of an eventual auto restock.
NXPI.bear: Extended auto inventory correction; China local competition.
NXPI.buy: Auto semis restock with content growth resuming.

ON.thesis: SiC and image sensors at trough utilization — cyclical recovery play with EV content.
ON.bear: SiC pricing war with Chinese entrants; EV slowdown.
ON.buy: SiC utilization and margin trough confirmed.

TSLA.thesis: Optimus and FSD as embodied-AI options stapled to an auto cash engine.
TSLA.bear: Auto margins compressed; valuation embeds robotaxi success; key-man risk.
TSLA.buy: Robotaxi unit economics demonstrated at scale.
TSLA.sell: FSD progress stalls while auto share erodes.

ISRG.thesis: Surgical-robotics near-monopoly; da Vinci 5 cycle with a razor-blade instruments annuity.
ISRG.bear: Premium multiple; procedure-mix macro; domestic China competition.
ISRG.buy: dV5 upgrade cycle with procedure growth above 15%.
ISRG.sell: Procedure growth decelerates as competitors gain traction.

CGNX.thesis: Machine vision for factory automation; AI vision products into a capex recovery.
CGNX.bear: Factory capex cycle depressed; logistics demand lumpy.

MBLY.thesis: ADAS incumbency upselling toward supervision/chauffeur autonomy.
MBLY.bear: China EV in-housing gutted growth; Intel ownership overhang.
MBLY.buy: Supervision design wins at western OEMs scaling.

OUST.thesis: Digital lidar for industrial autonomy and smart infrastructure.
OUST.bear: Lidar sector cash-burn history; slow auto adoption; dilution.
OUST.buy: Sustained GM above 40% with a credible EBITDA path.

NBIS.thesis: Ex-Yandex team building a full-stack AI cloud; Microsoft deal validated the model.
NBIS.bear: Capex race against giants; financing needs; post-contract utilization risk.
NBIS.buy: Additional anchor contracts with capacity milestones on time.
NBIS.sell: Financing terms worsen or utilization gaps appear.

CRWV.thesis: THE neocloud — NVIDIA-blessed with massive contracted backlog from Microsoft/OpenAI.
CRWV.bear: Extreme leverage and customer concentration; GPU depreciation versus obsolescence; renewal risk.
CRWV.buy: Backlog diversification plus refinancing at tighter spreads.
CRWV.sell: An anchor contract renegotiation or pause.

IREN.thesis: Bitcoin miner pivoting to AI cloud with owned power and land bank.
IREN.bear: Pivot execution, GPU financing, dual-story volatility.
IREN.buy: Multi-year AI contracts filling new capacity.
IREN.sell: AI utilization disappoints — back to mining beta.

CORZ.thesis: Post-bankruptcy HPC hosting anchored by CoreWeave contracts; strategic-target history.

CIFR.thesis: Miner-to-HPC conversions on PPA-backed cheap power.
CIFR.bear: Each conversion needs financing; execution and dilution risk.
CIFR.buy: A signed hyperscaler or AI-tenant lease.

WULF.thesis: Nuclear-adjacent (zero-carbon) HPC conversion story at Lake Mariner.
WULF.buy: An anchor AI lease at scale.

APLD.thesis: Purpose-built AI campuses (Ellendale) with Macquarie financing and CoreWeave leases.
APLD.bear: Leverage stack, tenant concentration, build execution.
APLD.buy: Ellendale fully leased and financed to completion.
APLD.sell: A financing gap or tenant slip.

DUOT.thesis: Micro-cap rail-inspection tech rebranding toward edge data-center operations.
DUOT.buy: Signed edge-DC contracts with real revenue.

BX.thesis: Largest alt manager; infra and credit funds financing the buildout (QTS, DC credit).
BX.bear: Rate cycle, real-estate legacy book, FRE growth priced richly.
BX.buy: DC/infra fundraising supercycle visible in fee-related earnings.

BAM.thesis: Asset-light manager atop Brookfield's infrastructure, renewables and data-center platforms.
BAM.buy: Flagship infra fund closes above target.

KKR.thesis: Infrastructure and private-credit engine with a capital-markets flywheel.
KKR.bear: Insurance rate sensitivity; PE exit drought.
KKR.buy: Infra fundraising and the monetization window reopen together.

APO.thesis: Private-credit origination machine (Athene) funding data-center and energy debt.
APO.bear: Spread compression; insurance leverage optics; credit cycle.
APO.sell: Credit spreads blow out with marks.

ARES.thesis: Credit-first alt manager growing infrastructure debt fastest.
ARES.bear: Valuation premium to peers; credit cycle.
